sonnet.problem: Verse 30 is outside the closing quotation marks of verse 29, and the text does not say who speaks it. The card says 'Then He says' and calls it the LORD's words. That names a speaker the text does not name.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.

sonnet.problem: The question says the horrible and shocking thing 'starts with the prophets'. Verse 30 only says a horrible and shocking thing has happened, and verse 31 then describes the prophets and priests. The text does not say how the two connect, and the card decides that they do.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.

sonnet.problem: 'It doesn't stop with the prophets' repeats the same added link, that the shocking thing grows out of the prophets and then spreads to the priests. The text does not state that link.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open: who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
